Speaker: Kael
Text: Three years. Three years since the Rift tore through Brasshollow and took everything.

Speaker: Kael
Text: Maren is gone. But Lira... she's still out there, somewhere in the Ethereal Realm.

Speaker: Kael
Text: Dr. Ashcroft's device nearly worked. I saw the other side — just for a moment. It's real.

Speaker: Kael
Text: I need Harmonic Crystals to stabilize the crossing. One for each realm. I have to find Lira before the Rift closes for good.

Speaker: Kael
Text: First things first — the Elder may know something. He was here when the Rift opened.
